records.title: FOXO3::STRADA/CCDC47
records.dna_only: DNA split reads establish a recurrent somatic rearrangement, but breakends alone do not identify the expressed splice path, CDS start, or junction reading frame.
records.decision_reason: The top-ranked fusion has 55 DNA and 31 RNA split reads, yet the directly observed ONT junction window has no exact collinear annotated donor; translation is withheld.
records.interpretation: Strong cross-platform support establishes an expressed rearrangement, not an antigen. This is the clearest example of evidence strength and peptide readiness being separate questions.
records.limitation: A longer assembled transcript with justified CDS/frame is required before junction-spanning peptides can be enumerated.
records.summary_rna: 55 DNA + 31 RNA split reads across four timepoints; donor frame unresolved
records.epitope_message: Not predicted because the observed junction has no justified donor CDS/frame.

records.title: PARD3B::CDKN2B-AS1/CDKN2B
records.dna_only: The recurrent t(2;9) is a compelling somatic rearrangement but DNA does not specify the expressed transcript or reading frame.
records.decision_reason: The positive-control fusion has 119 DNA and 48 RNA split reads; two direct T1 ONT witnesses include a 12-nt junction insertion, but no exact annotated donor CDS is established.
records.interpretation: The event is biologically credible and transcribed across timepoints, while its antigen sequence remains unresolved. Vaxrank therefore reports evidence but performs no peptide ranking.
records.limitation: The 12 inserted junction nucleotides and absent donor-frame assignment make naive reference-splicing translation unsafe.
records.summary_rna: 119 DNA + 48 RNA split reads; direct ONT junction includes 12 inserted nt
records.epitope_message: Not predicted because the sample-specific junction CDS/frame is unresolved.

records.title: AMPH 4.3-kb internal deletion
records.dna_only: LINX/ESVEE resolves a 4.3-kb deletion with both breakends in AMPH and junction copy number 1.87.
records.decision_reason: No RNA split read supports the junction, so no sample-specific transcript, exon consequence, reading frame, or mutant protein is admitted.
records.interpretation: This DNA-only event is a useful negative control: structural resolution at the genome level is insufficient for Vaxrank antigen construction.
records.limitation: Absence of RNA split reads may reflect absent expression or assay sensitivity; it is not proof that the DNA event is false.
records.summary_rna: DNA-supported 4.3-kb deletion; no RNA split reads
records.epitope_message: Not predicted because no expressed junction sequence is available.

rna_evidence.counts_text: 4.3-kb AMPH deletion; JCN 1.87; 0 RNA split reads

records.title: chr21 unnamed long-read-rich junction
records.dna_only: Two tumor-DNA split reads across T1 and T2 meet the site's multi-sample somatic threshold, but the breakends do not identify a coding transcript.
records.decision_reason: The junction has 32 RNA split reads, including 29 across ONT and PacBio, yet both partners are unnamed and no CDS start or frame is justified; translation is withheld.
records.interpretation: This is the clearest additional long-read-dependent expression example: long reads dominate the RNA evidence, but abundant support still cannot substitute for a defensible coding model.
records.limitation: The GC-rich chr21 locus has many nearby junction calls and unnamed partners, so mapping complexity and transcript identity must be resolved before antigen construction.
records.summary_rna: 29 ONT/PacBio + 3 short-read RNA witnesses; unnamed CDS/frame
records.epitope_message: Not predicted because neither partner has an identified coding transcript or reading frame.

records.title: DLG5 79.5-kb start-region deletion
records.dna_only: The deletion removes five ENST00000372391 coding exons, including the annotated start codon, but genomic loss does not identify an expressed mutant transcript or a replacement translation start.
records.decision_reason: Neither ONT nor Illumina RNA contains the somatic deletion junction. Both instead support canonical DLG5 RNA from an intact allele, so translation of the deletion is withheld.
records.interpretation: Long reads phase up to four canonical exon junctions on one molecule while short reads provide deeper local junction support. That platform difference strengthens the intact-transcript interpretation but creates no mutant peptide.
records.limitation: Reference-spliced RNA may arise from the intact allele; absence of a mutant RNA junction does not prove the DNA event is false or transcriptionally silent in every cell.
records.summary_rna: No mutant junction; ONT phases four WT junctions, Illumina supports the local WT splice
records.epitope_message: Not predicted because no deletion-junction transcript, CDS start, or mutant protein was observed.

rna_evidence.counts_text: 0 deletion-junction fragments; two T1 and two T2 ONT reads span four canonical junctions; local canonical short-read junction 130 T1 / 51 T2
rna_evidence.gate_status: HELD OUT: NO MUTANT RNA JUNCTION

records.title: AFF3 128-bp intronic deletion
records.dna_only: The focal deletion is wholly intronic in every inspected Ensembl 87 coding transcript; an altered protein would require a demonstrated splice or regulatory consequence.
records.decision_reason: ONT and Illumina RNA recover the same canonical AFF3 coding splice across the affected intron, with no altered exon boundary or deletion-specific RNA junction.
records.interpretation: Long reads add multi-exon isoform linkage and short reads add local junction support, but the mature coding sequence is identical on both platforms and supplies no mutant peptide.
records.limitation: Mature RNA cannot directly retain evidence for a small deletion inside a constitutively removed intron; this audit does not test every possible regulatory effect.
records.summary_rna: Same coding splice in ONT and Illumina; deleted DNA is absent through ordinary splicing
records.epitope_message: Not predicted because no altered coding RNA or mutant protein sequence was observed.

rna_evidence.counts_text: canonical 99649666|99672538 junction: ONT 6 T1 / 16 T2; Illumina 26 T1 / 15 T2; 0 deletion-specific junctions
rna_evidence.gate_status: HELD OUT: NO CODING RNA CHANGE

records.title: KEAP1 211-bp intronic/noncoding deletion
records.variant_class: DNA-supported intronic deletion overlapping a noncoding exon
records.dna_only: The deletion is intronic in all inspected coding transcripts but removes 35 nt from an exon of processed noncoding transcript ENST00000588024, which has no CDS.
records.decision_reason: Both platforms strongly support the unchanged coding splice. Illumina samples the noncoding isoform, but no complete T2 deletion-allele transcript path or coding consequence is observed.
records.interpretation: This is a real platform difference in transcript evidence: short reads detect a noncoding isoform absent from the ONT slice. It does not change the coding protein or vaccine-peptide pool.
records.limitation: The complete noncoding isoform is supported in T1, before the acquired T2 DNA event; two T2 upstream-junction reads alone do not establish a mutant noncoding transcript.
records.summary_rna: Coding splice agrees; Illumina alone samples a noncoding isoform, with no coding peptide effect
records.epitope_message: Not predicted because the observed platform difference is noncoding and no mutant CDS exists.

rna_evidence.counts_text: canonical coding junction: ONT 473 T1 / 535 T2, Illumina 98 T1 / 63 T2; complete processed-isoform junction support only in T1 Illumina
rna_evidence.gate_status: HELD OUT: NONCODING DIFFERENCE / NO MUTANT CDS

records.title: GABBR1::SLC29A1
records.dna_only: DNA establishes a somatic chr6 rearrangement, but its displayed genomic flank concatenation is not an assembled fusion transcript.
records.decision_reason: Direct tagged-BAM inspection recovered two complete T1 and three complete T2 ONT paths with reciprocal supplementary alignments; no productive orientation, CDS start or reading frame is yet justified.
records.interpretation: GABBR1::SLC29A1 is a genuine long-read transcript-reconstruction candidate: complete RNA paths exist in two samples, but coding interpretation remains separate from junction detection.
records.limitation: The public deduplicated ONT BAMs retain SA declarations without all matching observed partner records; validation used tagged BAMs and does not establish independent molecules or a translated product.
records.summary_rna: Complete ONT paths: 2 T1 + 3 T2; CDS/frame unresolved
records.epitope_message: Not predicted because complete RNA junction paths do not yet establish a translated CDS/frame.

rna_evidence.counts_text: 2 complete T1 paths and 3 complete T2 paths; website also reports 1 T3 split observation not independently checked here
rna_evidence.gate_status: HELD OUT: CODING ORIENTATION / FRAME UNRESOLVED

records.title: OTUD7A::FMN1
records.dna_only: The DNA junction includes a reported 2-nt CT insertion, but genomic donor/acceptor labels and inserted bases cannot be transferred blindly into a transcript translation.
records.decision_reason: Eight compatible complete T2 ONT paths were recovered, carrying six distinct cell/UMI labels; the coding orientation and frame remain unresolved.
records.interpretation: OTUD7A::FMN1 is the strongest new single-sample long-read SV lead. The molecule labels improve provenance, but neither read count nor labels substitute for a reconstructed coding transcript.
records.limitation: Eight paths are not eight proven independent molecules because some share cell/UMI labels; no translated junction peptide is claimed.
records.summary_rna: 8 complete T2 ONT paths; 6 cell/UMI labels; CDS/frame unresolved
records.epitope_message: Not predicted because no evidence-backed coding orientation or reading frame is available.
